data.name: Jamie
data.gender_notes: Jamie is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Scottish and English 'James', Jamie means 'supplanter' or 'replacer'. In the Bible, James is described as 'a servant of God and a leader among the apostles.'. The name Jamie carries the meaning “Supplanter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Jamie usually hope their child will grow to embody supplanter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes replacing the old with the new and faithful service to God.
data.etymology: Jamie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supplanter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamie total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: ג'יימי
in_hebrew.meaning: החלפת השם ג'יימי מקורה מהעברית ומשמעותו תפוח הדעת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'יימי הוא גרסה קצרה של השם יעקב, שמקורו בשפה העברית. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'עקב', שפירושה 'להחליף' או 'לתפוס בעקב'. השם יעקב ניתן למשיח הראשון, בנו של יצחק ורבקה, ונחשב לאחד השמות החשובים ביותר בתנ'ך. השם ג'יימי הוא שינוי אנגלי של השם הסקוטי 'ג'יימי', שגם הוא קשור לשם יעקב. השם משקף את התכונות של אדם שהוא נאמן, כנה, ובעל קשר חזק לאמונה הנוצרית ולמסורת היהודית.

in_greek.name: Τζέιμι
in_greek.meaning: Το Τζέιμι προέρχεται από το Ιακώβ και σημαίνει υποκαθιστά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζέιμι είναι μια σύντομη μορφή του ονόματος Ιακώβ, το οποίο έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή γλώσσα. Στην ελληνική Βίβλο, το όνομα Ιακώβ αναφέρεται στον πατριάρχη Ιακώβ, τον γιο του Ισαακ και της Ρεβέκκα. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'עקב' (עקב), που σημαίνει 'να υποκαταστήσει' ή 'να πάρει τη θέση'. Στην παράδοση των πρώτων Χριστιανών, το όνομα Ιακώβ και οι παραλλαγές του, όπως το Τζέιμι, συμβολίζουν την πίστη, την αφοσίωση και την πνευματική ανάπτυξη.

in_latin.name: Iacobus
in_latin.meaning: Iamien comes from Iacobus, meaning supplanter or replacing
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Jamie originates from the Latinized form of Iacobus, which is derived from the Hebrew name Ya'aqov. This name is associated with Jacob, the biblical figure and patriarch, who was the son of Isaac and Rebecca. The etymology of the name is linked to the Hebrew word 'עקב' (aqab), meaning 'to supplant' or 'to replace'. In the early Christian Church, the name Iacobus and its variants were significant, symbolizing faith, perseverance, and spiritual growth.

in_english.name: Jamie
in_english.meaning: Derived from Jacob, meaning supplanter or one who replaces
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jamie is a shortened form of James, which originates from the Hebrew name Ya'aqov (יעקב), meaning 'supplanter' or 'one who replaces'. It is associated with Jacob, a key figure in the Bible, who was the son of Isaac and Rebecca. The name has been adapted into various languages and cultures, maintaining its significance in Christian tradition. Jamie symbolizes qualities such as loyalty, honesty, and a strong connection to faith and heritage. Historically, the name James (and its variants like Jamie) has been popularized by several saints and biblical figures, including James, the brother of Jesus.

data.cultural_impact: Jamie is a unisex name that has gained immense popularity among various English speaking communities, particularly in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It has been a common name in literature, television, and film, with famous Jammies including Jamie Oliver (celebrity chef), Jamie Foxx ( actor), and Jamie Lee Curtis ( actress).
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Jamie is deeply rooted in the legacy of St. James, one of the twelve apostles named in the New Testament. As a servant of God and a leader among his peers, St. James represents the spiritual qualities of faith, courage, and leadership. For those with the name Jamie, these qualities may be a source of inspiration and motivation, reminding us to serve God and pursue our purpose with faithfulness and boldness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jamie: God's praiser, one who brings joy to the Lord. Derived from James, meaning 'supplanter' or 'replacer,' symbolizing the belief that God is the ultimate source of our identity and worth.

biblical_reference.note: The name Jamie is derived from Jacob, who was named in Genesis 25:26.

historical_references.reference: James Ford Secretan was a Scottish-American philosopher, who converted to Christianity from Catholicism in the late 18th century. He is best known for his work 'A Treatise on the Sense of Duty'. In his autobiography, he mentions that his Christian name 'James' was given to him by his adoptive parents.
